label.text: The items below will expire within 90 days. Try to sell them first, run an offer, or return them to the supplier before they go to waste.

row-actions.script: def nowLong = ec.user.nowTimestamp.getTime() def expLong = expiryDate?.getTime() ?: 0 daysToExpiry = expLong > 0 ? (int)((expLong - nowLong) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) : 999 isExpired = daysToExpiry <= 0
